title: oh.war/amendment/v1
description: Hand-written and normative for the frozen record `oh.war/amendment/v1` (docs/COMPATIBILITY.md): a section 31 amendment record, `docs/warrants/<alias>/amendments/<id>.yaml`. The file is a structured atom (the restricted YAML subset of OW-ADR-0003, never full YAML), read into this JSON object exactly as that reader holds it: every scalar a string (no implicit typing, so `re_preflight_required` is the string `"true"` or `"false"`), a flow sequence an array of strings, and a block sequence of flat mappings an array of objects. Where this schema and the prose that governs the record (docs/COMPATIBILITY.md, SAS sections 30 and 31) disagree, the prose wins and this schema is the defect. Not expressed here: that `id` agrees with the file name, the order of amendments, and what the amendment changed.
$comment: Written from crates/openwarrant-core/src/autonomy.rs: `AmendmentRecord` at autonomy.rs:187, `from_structured` at autonomy.rs:283 and `AmendmentRecord::validate` at autonomy.rs:220; the band vocabulary at autonomy.rs:70; `ContractElement` at crates/openwarrant-core/src/contract.rs:193 (`parse`); the restricted reader at crates/openwarrant-core/src/structured.rs:269; the top-level `sas_revision` pin at crates/openwarrant-cli/src/repo.rs:1609 (OW-ADR-0016); the writers at crates/openwarrant-cli/src/amendment_id.rs:253 and crates/openwarrant-cli/src/sas_repin.rs:251. The reader does not check `schema` and ignores keys it does not read; this schema refuses an unknown key, because a frozen record gains a member only when its schema does (docs/COMPATIBILITY.md, Additive only). The reader reads an `artifact_admissibility` other than `inadmissible` as `remain_admissible`, and a `re_preflight_required` other than `true` (any case) as false. autonomy.rs is pinned by resolved OW-WAR-0010, which is why `war schemas` does not generate this schema.

schema.description: Every frozen record names its schema (docs/COMPATIBILITY.md); the amendment reader itself does not read this key.

band.description: The section 30 band the change falls into.

semantic_diff.description: Section 31's structured semantic diff: at least one changed contract element.

element.description: One of section 28.5's seventeen contract elements.

sas_revision.description: OW-ADR-0016: the SAS revision this amendment re-pins the Warrant to (`war sas repin`).

predecessor_sas_revision.description: The SAS revision a re-pin moves from; written beside `sas_revision` (sas_repin.rs:263), read by no reader.

allOf.description: Sections 30.2 and 30.3: a band that creates a revision names the authority for it.
Section 31: when earlier work no longer holds, readiness is re-established.
